name: Anas Rasyid
headline: Hi — I am Anas Rasyid, I'm a game programmer focused on Unity.
subhead: I build gameplay features, performance-focused systems, and editor tooling to ship polished games.
bio: A proactive and analytical individual with a strong passion for problem-solving and eager to learn. I approach challenges from multiple perspectives to identify the most effective and efficient solutions. Confident in communicating ideas and providing constructive input within team environments. Specifically enthusiastic about game development, I stay up to date with emerging technologies and enjoy applying industry innovations in practical, results-driven ways—both professionally and with the same curiosity I bring to gameplay
